# Version  0.1.0a1

#### Code Improvements

* [#3](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/3): Adopt PyKale Gaussian fusion APIs in KaleCardiac
* [#5](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/5): Compute kalecardiac.evaluate with PyKale's kale.evaluate
* [#6](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/6): Adopt PyKale fusion and evaluation in KaleCardiac
* [#8](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/8): Accept positional options in the expert fusion registry
* [#9](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/9): Restore KaleCardiac fusion and evaluation imports
* [#10](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/10): Add PyKale's repository automation and unwrap Markdown

#### Documentation Updates

* [#1](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/1): Document fusion and evaluation contracts before PyKale migration
* [#7](https://github.com/pykale/cardiac/pull/7): Record and test weight normalization in Gaussian fusion
